title: The Half-Light Language
author: Ansel Eriksen
blurb: Silas Almeida, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
